title: Reverse a Section of the Parade
statement: Floats in a parade are a linked list of float numbers. The organizers want the floats from position `left` to position `right` (counting from 1) to go in reverse order; the rest stay where they are. Reverse that section in place and return the head.

answerKey.pattern: Walk to the node before the section, then reverse the section and reconnect both ends
keyPoints: Use a dummy node so left = 1 needs no special case
Move a pointer before to position left - 1
Reverse right - left + 1 nodes with prev, curr, and a saved next
Reconnect: the old first node of the section points to curr, and before.next points to prev
edgeCases: The section starts at the head
The section ends at the last node
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Copy values to an array, reverse the section, write them back: O(n) extra space

hints: Which node stays just before the section, and which node comes just after it?
Walk to the node before position left. Then reverse exactly right - left + 1 nodes, as in Return Trip.
After reversing, the section's old first node is now its last: point it at the node after the section, and point the node before the section at the new first node.
